component.name: VanillaAgent
component.summary: Sovereign autonomous AI agent runtime and swarm engine

description.p: VanillaAgent is a sovereign autonomous agent runtime: it holds its own EVM and Solana wallet, pays for its own compute, runs continuously across local machines or cloud sandboxes and coordinates work inside multi-agent swarms.

The Web GUI control panel (served on http://localhost:3000) provides a cockpit, mission control chat, a five-tier memory explorer, a swarm task graph and a treasury view of the agent's on-chain balances.
